proposal.hypothesis: Moving best-seed-quality map updates inside the seed-confirmation branch will remove three unordered-map operations from every emitted seed in the Development configuration and reduce median seeding time without changing selected seeds.
proposal.falsifier: The prediction fails if median seeding time does not decrease from fresh Genesis or timed seeding particle efficiency changes.
proposal.expected_hot_path: Acts::BroadTripletSeedFilter::filterTripletsMiddleFixed emitted-seed state updates with seedConfirmation disabled.
proposal.novelty_reason: Prior map work reduced duplicate lookup cost, while this candidate removes the entire inactive map data flow under the existing configuration invariant and does not alter candidate ordering or selection.

source_references.relevance: The permanent upstream implementation shows best-seed-quality state helpers and the filter output path that maintains this state even though reads are guarded by seed confirmation.
source_references.inspected_scope: BroadTripletSeedFilter getBestSeedQuality/setBestSeedQuality helpers and filterTripletsMiddleFixed seed-confirmation and emitted-seed quality-state flow.
source_references.acts_mapping: Upstream Acts::BroadTripletSeedFilter::filterTripletsMiddleFixed maps directly to optimization-files/Core/src/Seeding2/BroadTripletSeedFilter.cpp; the Development example leaves Config::seedConfirmation false.

source_references.relevance: The directly inspected prior implementation showed map lookup cost was measurable, but optimized each update rather than pruning disabled confirmation state.

evidence.lesson: The one-event smoke segfaulted after a successful build, so the quality-map updates cannot be pruned safely under the assumed disabled-confirmation invariant.
evidence.prediction_assessment_rationale: The smoke stage crashed before any timed or seeding-efficiency evidence was produced.
